title: Recipe service generation needs an explicit paired provider and exact kernel pin
body: The first queued VIXEN configure/build used the auto-derived home-directory Yeroket provider and tracked pin 4abf...; the recipe_services_codegen step returned success but produced no service outputs, and the fresh target build failed before consumer compilation. Recovery manually paired this VIXEN worktree with /home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy/.claude-worktrees/recipevix2 and supplied the full kernel SHA 08a5b420a744b110dd8f3ce132606ecb45aa9255 via VIXEN_YEROKET_KERNEL_SHA_OVERRIDE, then reran the documented recipe_services_codegen and recipe_simd_regen targets and the build passed. Provider setup/codegen should declare and validate the paired provider root and exact revision before generation, so the default graph cannot report a successful empty-output generation followed by a target failure.
